studies.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fresh, detailed product design exploration board for visual[flow], a picture-first node canvas. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Title "01 / Choose the movement". Three equal panels left to right: "Approach", "Try", "Keep". Premium restrained application UI, warm off-white canvas, crisp charcoal outlines, soft flat white preview tiles, precise small sans serif labels, amber numeric connection, subtle violet artwork; no paper sketch, no glass/chrome, no dashboard. Each panel shows the SAME small source tile on left containing a soft amber pulse dot (no waveform), same large square target tile on right containing a beautiful violet radial rosette. All three target tiles and cable anchor positions fixed across panels. Panel 1: drag a single amber cable from source to a small socket midway along target left edge, faint amber border highlights target; no parameter controls. Panel 2: a shallow attached shelf grows DOWNWARD from target, sharing its outline, with three tiny rosette thumbnails showing distinct visual outcomes, labels "Breathe", "Turn", "Flutter"; Breathe selected with thin amber outline. Target preview visibly shows expanded petal radius with faint narrow ghost contour indicating breathing excursion. Source, cable and target stay in their exact positions. Panel 3: shelf gone, usable rosette result persists, tiny integrated left-edge connector badge "3" indicates three configured routes; no exposed parameters. Beneath board one short sentence: "Choose a look. Keep a working arrangement." Add small unobtrusive bottom note "Concept study · previews illustrate proposed behavior". Important: UI affordances read as part of target, not floating panels. Exact readable minimal text. Show actual rosette variation, not three identical previews. No large arrows, callout clutter, toolbars or global side panels.
studies.correction: Edit this design board only to fix the small pulse source caption in all three panels: replace the word 'Image' below the amber-dot source tile with 'Pulse'. Keep all other content, geometry, colors and artwork unchanged.

studies.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create fresh detailed product design exploration board for visual[flow]. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Title "02 / Less movement, same rhythm". Three equal panels "Rest", "Focus spread", "Tighten". Restrained warm off-white software canvas, charcoal thin borders, flat white square preview tiles, refined sans serif typography, amber signal, violet rosette artwork. Same target preview tile repeated at IDENTICAL size and position within each panel. An amber cable enters a FIXED socket at middle left edge in every frame. Panel 1 quiet beautiful rosette preview and tiny joined connector marked "3". Panel 2 reveals an attached crescent-shaped wing along left side of preview; wing and tile share ONE continuous outline. Fixed cable socket stays at its original location and does not move as wing grows around it. Exactly ONE selected circular adjustment grows around this fixed socket, with a dark inner base pointer and thin amber outer depth arc, label "Spread". Two tiny unselected route dots above/below hint at other routes; no permanent parameter strip. Preview shows two faint ghost petal envelopes around solid rosette, wide excursion. Panel 3 identical wing and same dial diameter/center; pointer angle unchanged, amber depth arc shortened from about 100 degrees to about 35 degrees, visible cursor at arc end. Ghost petal envelopes now much closer, solid preview same mean size. Tiny value under dial "+0.12", previous panel "+0.35". Annotation below board: "Drag the amber arc to reduce movement. Base and other routes stay put." Small footer "Concept study · click or focus keeps the control open". Prioritize fixed geometry, visual range change, one correction. No physical chrome, glass, fader banks, extra graphs, waveforms, arbitrary arrows. This is a fresh polished app mock, not a pencil sketch.
studies.correction: Revise this board's connector geometry while retaining its title, three panels, rosette previews, warm minimal app aesthetic and range change. In every panel the amber cable must terminate at EXACTLY the middle of the target picture tile's LEFT BORDER, at the same normalized position within its panel. Rest panel shows tiny '3' socket there. Focus and Tighten panels: remove the large full-height wing and move the dial center to that EXACT same socket coordinate on the picture tile left border. Replace the wing with a SMALL rounded lobe, about one-third tile height, fused into the tile left border and growing only leftward around the fixed socket/dial center. The circular dial straddles the old socket location, half outside the original tile, half inside; the cable ends at dial center, never at the new outside edge. Dial center and diameter identical between Focus and Tighten. Keep base pointer angle identical, shorten only amber depth arc. Keep 'Spread', +0.35 and +0.12 as relevant, tiny two other route dots. Picture tile size and position exactly equal across panels, no preview shrink or shift. No hanging '3' box to the left of expanded control. Preserve wide ghost excursion in Focus and tight excursion in Tighten. This specific correction is about a stable cable endpoint and a compact one-control lobe, not a permanent side panel.

studies.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create fresh detailed design exploration board for visual[flow], a picture-first node canvas. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Title "03 / Try a new source, keep the arrangement". Three equal panels "Current", "Compare", "Replaced". Warm off-white app canvas, crisp dark charcoal fine borders, flat white preview nodes, restrained amber numeric signal, violet rosette artwork, elegant small sans serif labels. SAME target rosette square fixed in each panel, with an integrated tiny connector marked "3" at mid-left; no parameter bank. Panel 1: small amber pulse-source tile upper left connected to target, target shows rosette with faint expanding petal contour. Panel 2: old source remains upper left with old cable dim but still connected; second small source tile lower left contains three small discrete amber dots, new amber cable dragged toward SAME fixed target socket. Attached shelf grows below target as part of same outline, with two side-by-side thumbnail previews labeled "Current" and "New", the new rosette visibly staggered petals. Two small explicit actions in shelf "Cancel" and "Replace". A tiny line in shelf says "Keeps 3 routes and their ranges". New preview amber outlined, not yet committed. Panel 3: ONLY new source connected; old source still visible upper left, disconnected, not deleted. Shelf closed, same target position, connector still "3", rosette shows staggered variant. Small quiet "Undo" below target. Footer "Concept study · source replacement preserves destination settings". Replacement applies to one existing source's three numeric destination routes; do not depict adding or mixing sources. Cable colors clear, source nodes retained, no invented knobs, no popup modal, no trash bin, no arrows between panels. Board should explain a reversible taste decision visually.
